input.rationale: Clear motor-vehicle collision claim: rear-end impact causing vehicle damage and policyholder injury.

Vehicle is totaled (damage well exceeds $25,000) and policyholder has documented injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist qualify as minor injuries); totaled vehicles automatically elevate to high severity.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light yesterday at ~8:15 AM by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat) and policyholder suffered whiplash and sprained wrist. High-severity claim with documented injuries and vehicle loss; other driver's insurance info available on police report.
